description: Smoke test of the campus-customs MCP server from inside the vibe coder (Claude Code). The server is registered in .mcp.json at the project root and was called through Claude Code's MCP connection, not by running Python directly.
vibe_coder: Claude Code 2.1.295 (Claude desktop app, Code tab), session opened in the HW 5 project folder
student_prompt: ok P4, add the MCP server to this project so you can call the tools. Save the connection JSON text in the .mcp.json at the project root. Make sure you can call it. ... test each of the three MCP tools, save the evidence in the mcp_smoke.json. for every tool, make sure you have 1. the prompt you asked the vibe coder. 2. the tool name. 3. the tool output (must have value match in the campus customs new file).

tests.prompt_source: vibe coder's per-tool request, written from the student's prompt above
tests.prompt: Ticket 101 links invoice 501. Use the campus-customs MCP tool to look up invoice 501: is it overdue as of the shop's today, by how many days, and will the vendor ship?

db_check.sql: SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE id = 501; SELECT * FROM vendors WHERE id = 1; SELECT date_today FROM desk;
db_check.derived: days_overdue = 2026-08-31 - 2026-08-28 = 3; vendor 1 has 1 open invoice, so vendor_will_ship = false

tests.output_matches: data/campus_customs.db (identical to the working copy at test time, SHA-1 f447ca6a…)

recheck_after_graded_run.vibe_coder: Claude Code, session in the HW 5 folder
recheck_after_graded_run.what_changed: Problem 9: a human approved payment #1 ($840), so invoice 501 is now 'paid' and Bulldog Print Co will ship again.

tests.prompt_source: vibe coder's per-tool request, written from the student's prompt above
tests.prompt: Ticket 102 is Elm City Properties' rent notice for lease 1. Use the campus-customs MCP tool to check lease 1: what is the rent, when is it due, and how many days until it is due?

db_check.sql: SELECT * FROM leases WHERE id = 1; SELECT date_today FROM desk;

tests.output_matches: data/campus_customs.db (identical to the working copy at test time, SHA-1 f447ca6a…)

recheck_after_graded_run.vibe_coder: Claude Code, session in the HW 5 folder
recheck_after_graded_run.what_changed: Problem 9: a human approved the $2,400 rent (payment #2), so lease 1's next_due moved from 2026-09-02 to 2026-10-02 (32 days after the shop's today).

tests.prompt_source: vibe coder's per-tool request, written from the student's prompt above
tests.prompt: Ticket 103: the Yale AI Club wants 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M. Use the campus-customs MCP tool to check stock: how many are on hand, what is the shortfall, and what are the cost, list price and margin?

db_check.sql: SELECT size, qty FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'CC-HOOD-NAVY'; SELECT * FROM pricing WHERE sku = 'CC-HOOD-NAVY';

tests.output_matches: data/campus_customs.db (identical to the working copy at test time, SHA-1 f447ca6a…)

recheck_after_graded_run.vibe_coder: Claude Code, session in the HW 5 folder
recheck_after_graded_run.what_changed: Unchanged: no tool sells or receives stock, so size M is still 8 on hand.

summary.all_outputs_match_db: Original outputs match campus_customs.db (the state at test time); recheck outputs match the committed campus_customs_new.db.
summary.database_unchanged_after_tests: yes at the time (2026-10-13): both .db files still hashed to SHA-1 f447ca6a… because these tools are read-only. The working copy changed later, in Problem 9's graded run (see database_state_note).

student_prompt_note: student_prompt is what the student actually typed (one instruction covering all three tools). Each test's prompt is the ticket-specific request the vibe coder turned that instruction into before calling the tool.
database_state_note: The 'output' of each test was captured in Problem 4 (2026-10-13), when campus_customs_new.db was still an exact copy of the original campus_customs.db; those values match campus_customs.db. Problem 9's graded run then paid invoice 501 and the rent, so the committed campus_customs_new.db differs for two tools. Each test therefore also has 'recheck_after_graded_run': the same tool called again from Claude Code on 2026-10-14 against the committed working copy, and those values match campus_customs_new.db as it is in the repo.
